entities.summary: Aki Shimizu  is a manga artist who hails from Ōmuta, Fukuoka. She contributed the art for Blood Sucker: Legend of Zipangu (2000), Graduale der Wolken (2001), and adapted a manga version of Suikoden III (2002) based on Konami's video game. She also work on the manga version of upcoming Suikoden: Star Leap (2025). Illustrating one of the 108 heroes, Shapur from Nameless Land.
